review_rules: Reachfolk religion must be modeled from clan-specific and Reachfolk sources where possible; outsider labels such as 'Daedra worship' must remain attributed
Do not treat the Forsworn as synonymous with all Reachfolk or project Fourth Era Forsworn politics onto earlier Reach societies
Red Eagle traditions should distinguish historical evidence, legend, ritual memory and later retellings
Briarheart creation and capabilities must separate observed ritual evidence from gameplay mechanics
Reach clans can differ substantially in patron spirits, customs and politics; preserve local variation
Cross-link existing Reachfolk, Reach, Forsworn, Markarth, Old Gods, Briarheart, Hagraven, Hircine, Namira, Peryite and Red Eagle-related records
